title: thymus funkii var. sabulicola
intro: Thymus funkii var. sabulicola, commonly known as the Sand Thyme, is a variety of the Thymus funkii plant, belonging to the Lamiaceae family. It is a shrub-like herb with fragrant, grayish-green leaves and produces small, white flowers. The health benefits of Sand Thyme include its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties, which can aid in wound healing, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Sand Thyme include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of soothing digestive issues and exerting antioxidant effects.
